Agent Name: Product Manager
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Product Manager created a file named "Filter_10761_I_attacked_solution.py" (which is a Python solution file) but filled it with Product Requirement Document (PRD) content (Markdown headers like "## Language & Project Info", "## Product Definition", etc.). This is a critical role boundary violation where the agent confused the task of creating a PRD (a document) with the task of implementing the solution (code). The file extension (.py) indicates it should contain executable Python code, not a requirements document. This error directly leads to the wrong solution because the final deliverable is a PRD document instead of the required Python implementation.
